title: FeatureVote
description: A single vote, upvote, or weighted demand signal cast by a customer on a road map item or feature request.

id.description: Stable identifier for the vote within the source platform.

item_id.description: Identifier of the road map item or feature request the vote is attached to.

voter.description: Information about the person or account casting the vote.

weight.description: Vote weight, often derived from account size, plan tier, or ARR.

comment.description: Optional comment left by the voter explaining the vote.
comment.example: Blocker for our security review, need SSO before we can roll out company-wide.

source_platform.description: Name of the platform of record for this vote.
